interface.shortDescription: 23 premium design skills for any AI agent — anti-AI-slop, premium, editorial, glassmorphism, neobrutalism & more
interface.longDescription: A portable collection of 23 structured design skills that work with any AI coding agent (Claude, GPT, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini, etc.). Each skill is a self-contained Markdown file with design tokens, anti-patterns, layout archetypes, component rules, motion guidelines, and quality gates. Includes Hallmark (anti-AI-slop), high-end-visual-design (Awwwards-tier agency), premium (Apple-inspired), editorial, sleek, minimal, modern, professional, refined, neobrutalism, glassmorphism, clean-minimal-beige-light-mode, nested-container-clean-agency, split-layout-technical, impeccable, beautiful-shadows, staggered-word-reveal, animation-on-scroll, landing-page, pricing-page, design-taste-frontend, redesign-existing-projects, and styleseed-design-review. Features a master orchestrator skill that auto-selects the right combination based on project type. No dependencies, no runtime, no special tooling required.
interface.defaultPrompt: I need to design a landing page / SaaS app / dashboard / portfolio / marketing site. Help me select the right design direction from the skill pack and apply it.
